releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v6.8.0 Precision Game AI & Autonomous OptiRouter Overhaul:
- Multi-Stage Precision Game Classifier: Rebuilt the AI game detection engine with strict 5-tier classification (Games, Creative 3D, Launchers, Browsers, System Shells).
- False Positive Elimination: Store clients and overlays (Steam, Epic Games Launcher, Riot Client, EA Desktop, Battle.net, OBS, Discord) and hardware-accelerated video decoding (YouTube 4K) are strictly excluded and will NEVER falsely trigger Gaming fan mode or dGPU wakeups.
- Direct 3D Engine & PE Inspection: Detects Unreal Engine, Unity, Source, RE Engine, REDengine, CryEngine, DirectX 12/11, Vulkan, DLSS, and Anti-Cheats (EAC, BattlEye).
- Dynamic DirectX GPU Auto-Router: High-Performance NVIDIA RTX 4060 dGPU for games and 3D rendering; Power-Saving AMD Radeon iGPU for browsers, office apps, and launchers.
- AMD Zen 4 Anti-Spike Governor & Whisper Cooling.
